physical.nuclear_repulsion: already in HAM; never add 1/R again

nested: same common u transferred from MEDIUM optimizer; degree-prefix tuple sets; restrictions 1,1

numerical.stability: 1e-10 Eh empirical, not formal error bound
numerical.choice: ND60 only if ND60/80 agree at NMAX120; N80 if 80/100 AND 100/120 agree; otherwise N100 if 100/120 agree; else STOP

optimizer.method: MEDIUM bounded pattern search; seed then both neighbors of current best at 1/4,1/8,1/16; ties lower u
optimizer.termination: fixed three levels complete, minimum step 1/16; no optimality claim
optimizer.objective: own accepted finite variational energy only
optimizer.failure: any rejected trial => STOP; no range expansion
optimizer.shared_u: one MEDIUM optimization; common u used for all sizes; calibration seed reusable with cost charged once

EN.subsequent: most recent accepted own E minus 1/256
EN.retry: same finite problem; returned finite own E minus 1/256 even if MAXIT; only hint, not accepted energy; re-audit

final_points: fresh SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE each; fresh NMAX+20 spot each; no Omega beyond7
validation: unchanged V1 interval checker + 240-digit measured residual/RQ and same four consistency checks; no new tolerance
noninterference: fresh unchanged VENDOR for every final point, identical scientific stdout and wf bytes
cost: same GNU time + outer wall wrapper; OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL=1; Windows checker sampled RSS distinct; include calibration, optimization, spots, validation, refused attempts
comparison_gate: all final/spot energies and source hashes sealed before separate reference comparison; fresh V5Z only if target met
max_scope: three sizes at R=.4 only; no B2, curve, production, A adoption, push
